Portable Project

🔊 Audio Quality Check

Compare the original file with Soundboard playback. Only test when not recording.

Original file playback bypasses the app's Soundboard gains and is NOT recorded. Soundboard playback uses clip volume, master volume, trims, and ducking. Comparison stops other audio.

Restore source-level loudness

New uploads default to 100%. Existing clips keep your saved levels (for example 80%) until you choose to change them.

Your music files are never modified. This changes only clip volume settings; individual fades and automatic ducking still work.

Device output check

Android/Bluetooth can switch to voice or hands-free output while a mic is active. Browser code cannot guarantee the same hardware output mode. Compare again after disconnecting or changing the output device if you hear tinny sound.
